name: Skip link
summary: A link to the main content, hidden off-screen until it gets keyboard focus.
description: Put it first in the <body> on every page, so keyboard users can jump past the header and navigation. It slides into view when it receives focus: press Tab in the demo to see it.

classes.name: v-skip-link
classes.description: The link. Fixed at the top start corner, off-screen until focused.

classes.name: v-skip-target
classes.description: On the main content: removes the focus ring around the whole region when the skip link moves focus there.

states.description: On the target, so focus really moves there and the next Tab continues from the content.

keyboard.action: The first Tab on the page focuses the skip link and shows it.
Moves focus to the main content.

a11y: Make it the first focusable element in the page.
Point it at the <main> element and give that element tabindex="-1", or focus may stay at the top in some browsers.
It uses the primary button colours, so it has full contrast when shown.

examples.title: Skip to content
examples.description: Click inside the frame, then press Tab: the link appears at the top. Press Enter to move focus to the main content.
